title: AI Nutrition Coach — choose the style of the docs & marketing site
question: Each preview is the site's first viewport (landing + the door into the docs). Keep the rolled direction, take an alternate, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Seed Packet Rack
options.lineage: garden seed packets and the hardware-store seed rack
options.thesis: Every feature is a seed packet on a rack: a bold flat-ink front that sells it, a back panel that tells you exactly how to sow it.
options.viewport: A cobalt rack header with the product name set like a seed brand, a row of tall packets (Photo, Barcode, Describe, Day Board, Your data) and a 'Sow it on your own server' action.
options.risk: Packet illustrations must be drawn with real care in flat SVG ink, or they slide into clip art.

raised.raise: Total palette commitment: the rack header floods the first viewport in cobalt instead of sitting on a polite neutral page.
Security page draws every default as a line pattern (solid = on, gap = off by default) so 'telemetry off, AI off, ask before every photo' reads at a glance.
The trust section prints the real outgoing requests (GET /api/v2/product/<barcode>?fields=) as evidence, not adjectives.
Back-of-packet how-to pages carry their history: what is planned is shown as an unopened packet, never as a feature.

options.label: Torchon, laid out
options.lineage: the app's own striped kitchen towel, unfolded to page size
options.thesis: The site is the towel the app is made of: each section is a woven band, each feature a dyed stripe, so the docs look exactly like the product.
options.viewport: A giant heavy 'Know what's on your plate.' over a full-width day towel woven live from the left, the phone screenshot laid on it, and an ink 'Run your own' pill.
options.risk: The most familiar choice and the safest brand fit: one world for app and site, less surprise on first visit.

options.label: Build Instructions
options.thesis: The docs are an assembly booklet: big step numerals, 1:1 call-outs of each screen, wordless arrows from tap to result.
options.viewport: Step 1 · 2 · 3 spread: install on your server, choose a passphrase, log your first plate, each with a call-out box of the real phone screen.
options.case: Fuses well for 'how to use it' (strongest clarity for the docs); weaker identification for a calm kitchen product's marketing page.
options.risk: Reads toy-like if the grid is loose; the playful register must stay calm in copy.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Every setting tied to its default by a drawn line.
options.viewport: Numbered amber lanes on black glass.
options.case: Fuses well for the security page only; household cooks do not identify with a machine room.
options.kept: Defaults drawn as line patterns on the security page.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The site as a live transcript.
options.case: Speaks to self-hosters, loses the household cook and the calm voice.
options.kept: Real outgoing requests printed as evidence in the trust section.
options.risk: Hacker cliché for a food app.

options.label: Rebel Menu Collage
options.thesis: Every option a torn shard slammed on a wall.
options.case: Red-on-everything fights the no-guilt, protein-only red rule; shouting breaks the calm voice.
options.kept: Total palette commitment in the first viewport.

options.label: Torn Billboard
options.thesis: Navigation by tearing into older layers.
options.case: Hides the offer; docs need findability, not archaeology.
options.kept: Planned work shown as its own honest layer, never mixed with what ships.

options.label: Bioluminescent Wake
options.case: No link to food, kitchens or ownership.
options.kept: One element lit at a time; the rest at rest.

canonCard.label: The house standard
canonCard.thesis: Like the finance coach: a hand-built landing page at the root plus MkDocs Material docs under /docs/, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, two CTAs and a phone screenshot on the left/right split, feature grid below, docs search in the header.
canonCard.risk: Consistent with your other coaches, and indistinguishable from most open-source landing pages by design.
